sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) documents unauthorized credit card fraud identified on customer account C11923. On 2016-12-29 03:27:44, flagged transaction 3583368 for $131.30 was detected via online channel with an elevated risk score of nan. Graph analytics and multi-hop link expansion revealed that the transaction was associated with device profile 'SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | Unknown | chrome 66.0 for android | Unknown', which was identified across 3 additional cardholder accounts (C03938-K1, C05595-K1, C05678-K1). The cardholder, when contacted for transaction validation, confirmed they did not authorize the transactions and remained in possession of their physical card. The activity exhibits characteristics consistent with card not present new device, where compromised credentials or card data were systematically exploited. Total cumulative fraudulent exposure across identified affected transactions (3583368) totals $131.30. The financial institution has taken immediate mitigating actions by blocking card C11923-K2 for reissue, opening internal case HHG-011 in graph memory, and placing all connected card accounts under continuous surveillance per Bank Policy R2, R6, and regulatory guidelines.
